boundary: Pass 6008 VERIFIES transitivity by explicit orbit computation, so |Stab| = 5040 is now computed rather than inferred. The identification of Stab with S_7 is NOT proved: 233 of 5040 permutations were found by sampling, and the conclusion rests on an order argument plus the presence of odd permutations

pass_6008_transitivity_verified.method: orbit of one 7-set under 21 symplectic transvection generators of Sp(6,2)
pass_6008_transitivity_verified.status: COMPUTED, not inferred -- last pass this was conditional on transitivity

pass_6009_the_induced_action.conclusion: consistent with Stab isomorphic to S_7 acting naturally and faithfully on the 7 points -- every permutation of the set realised by a symplectic map
pass_6009_the_induced_action.not_proved: only 233 of 5040 permutations were exhibited; the full image was not enumerated, and the kernel was not shown trivial
pass_6009_the_induced_action.so: the image is NOT contained in A_7
pass_6009_the_induced_action.the_order_argument: |Stab| = 5040 = 7! exactly, and the image contains odd permutations. A proper subgroup of S_7 containing odd permutations and of order at least 233 is essentially S_7 itself or a point-stabiliser S_6, and S_6 is not transitive on the seven points

pass_6010_the_two_sevens_are_opposite_ex.the_finding: the two 7-sets are at OPPOSITE EXTREMES of the symmetry scale. One carries a rigid 1+3+3 structure; the other carries none at all. That is why the numerical agreement alpha = 7 was meaningless, and it is a much stronger statement than 'different objects'

w33.reading: almost no symmetry on the seven points -- a fixed point and two triples, and 7 does not divide 18 so no transitive action

w52.reading: apparently ALL symmetry -- every permutation of the seven points realised, so nothing intrinsic distinguishes them

pass_6011_what_it_suggests.rank_2_vs_rank_3: at rank 2 the maximum partial ovoid is a structured object with a small stabiliser; at rank 3 it is a generic 7-subset with the full symmetric group. The design strength follows: 2-design at rank 2, 3-design at rank 3
pass_6011_what_it_suggests.the_open_question: whether design strength tracks rank generally -- rank 4 would predict a 4-design -- and whether the stabiliser is always the full symmetric group above rank 2
